hotspots.author: StockMKTNewz
hotspots.title: Anthropic与SpaceX算力协议的费用与条款
hotspots.fact: 帖子转述Anthropic与SpaceX的算力协议：费用最高1205亿美元，用于获取NVIDIA芯片算力；预计2026年12月全部交付后每月约31亿美元，协议延续至2029年，并含提前90天通知的取消安排。
hotspots.originalText:
ANTHROPIC AGREED TO SPEND UP TO $120.5B ON COMPUTE FROM SPACEX $SPCX
The deals are with SpaceX's AI unit, for access to Nvidia $NVDA chips
Once all the capacity is delivered, expected in December 2026, Anthropic will pay about $3.1B a month. The deals run into 2029.
After early periods ending in January and March 2027, either side can cancel with 90 days' notice.
hotspots.excerptNote: Grok返回的原文摘录；未展示部分不补写。

hotspots.originalText:
META RAISES $35 BILLION TO FUND AI EXPANSION
Meta ($META ) launched a $35B equity offering to finance AI infrastructure, including $22.5B in common stock and $12.5B in convertible preferred shares.
$NVDA, $AMD and $AVGO have expressed interest in investing up to $5B combined.
Meta targets $135B–$145B in 2026 capex, with another $60B stock-sale program planned for 2027.
The key risk: Rising AI financing needs and potential shareholder dilution.

hotspots.originalText: $TSM chart shows a clean move off the STL and out of the pink zone, in an uptrend, with perfect MACD and Stoch setups. Volume balance shows potential capitulation on the recent low, with above average inflows today. We bought calls today in the Live Options Room.
